_what: Every (arm, season) fold an OPEN prereg is holding BLIND. A harness that can read a fold calls blind_folds.refuse_if_blind(arm, season) at startup and STOPS unless --spend-blind-fold is passed, so a replication run cannot spend another lane's primary fold by accident (register 472: it happened twice in one day). A row here whose ledger row is no longer OPEN is stale and test_blind_folds fails on it — the registry cleans itself through the ledger.

folds.note: 2025 spent by register 463, 2024 by register 471; 2023 is the last blind fold
